title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Apple Peach Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: SKE Crystal Strawberry Raspberry Nic Salt brings together two classic berry flavours for a vibrant, fruity vape. The sweet, sun-kissed notes of Strawberry provide a smooth base, while Raspberry adds a tangy edge that cuts through the sweetness with a pleasant sharpness. The result is a balanced, berry-led profile that's simple yet satisfying ideal for vapers who enjoy clean, fruit-centric flavours with a touch of tartness. It's a familiar but well-executed combination that holds up well as an all-day vape. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as pod kits and starter pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it offers a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine absorption. SKE is renowned for delivering bold, satisfying flavours with sleek, user-friendly design. Their Crystal Bar disposables helped set a new standard for flavour clarity and convenience, and the SKE Crystal Nic Salt range continues that legacy offering the same popular flavours in a format compatible with a wide range of refillable pod kits and MTL vape devices. With a presence in over 50 countries, SKE remains at the forefront of vaping innovation.
